events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Southern Hudspeth Highlands; Rio Grande Valley of Eastern Hudspeth County
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 1033 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 8
miles east of Fort Quitman, moving northeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and half inch hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Sierra Blanca, Fort Quitman, Quitman Canyon, and Little Box.

This includes Interstate 10 in Texas between mile markers 103 and
118.

events.region: Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 0-20 nm; Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 20-60 nm
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
SMWMLB

The National Weather Service in Melbourne has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 0-20 nm...
Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 20-60 nm...

* Until 230 AM EDT.

* At 1230 AM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located near Patrick
Space Force Base, moving southwest at 25 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts to 34 knots.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Port Canaveral, Jetty Park, Cape Canaveral, Patrick Space Force
Base, Cocoa Beach, South Patrick Shores, Satellite Beach, Indian
Harbour Beach, Indialantic, Melbourne Beach, Spessard Holland Park,
Merritt Island, Georgiana, Palm Shores, Pineda, Eau Gallie,
Melbourne, Melbourne Shores, Floridana Beach and Rockledge.
